name: Royal Euro
oneLiner: REUR is the Royal Euro stablecoin from RIB Digital Holdings, targeting 1:1 backing with euro cash reserves held at top-tier international banks.
collateral: Euro cash reserves held through top-tier international banks to target 1:1 backing for each REUR issued by The RIB Digital Holdings Limited
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption route targeting 1 REUR = 1 EUR, subject to reserve sufficiency, redemption terms, and market conditions

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

reserves.name: Euro cash reserves at top-tier international banks

params.label: Euro cash reserves at top-tier international banks

mintAuthority.summary: REUR is issued by The RIB Digital Holdings Limited (Royal Coins, Hong Kong); minting and redemption run through the issuer's centralized backend targeting 1 REUR = 1 EUR against euro cash reserves at top-tier banks.

controls.label: RIB Digital Holdings issuance backend
controls.evidence: RIB/Royal Coins operates a centralized mint/redeem targeting 1:1 EUR backing subject to reserve sufficiency and redemption terms; a single issuer controls supply creation against custodied euro reserves.

review.evidence: Royal Coins materials describe an issuer-managed mint and redemption route targeting 1 REUR = 1 EUR backed by euro cash reserves at top-tier international banks; the same issuer (RIB Digital Holdings) operates RUSD, and no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Classification based on the issuer model described in RIB/Royal Coins materials; on-chain token owner/minter admin not independently resolved.
